description: This file defines functions for creating, sanitizing, serializing, and parsing store data related to application settings, including handling file paths, boolean options, and spell checker languages.

methods.name: createSanitizedStoreData
methods.description: Creates a sanitized StoreData object from input data, applying default values and validation.

methods.name: sanitizeZoomFactor
methods.description: Ensures the zoom factor is a positive number, defaults to 1.

methods.name: sanitizeBackupsLocation
methods.description: Validates and returns a directory path for backups, defaults to a constructed path based on environment.

methods.name: sanitizeSpellCheckerLanguageCodes
methods.description: Filters and returns a set of valid Language codes from input array.

methods.name: serializeStoreData
methods.description: Converts StoreData to JSON string, serializing Sets as arrays.

methods.name: parseDataFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file, parses it, and returns sanitized StoreData; handles errors gracefully.
